items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: But then Father Divine used to come in there... And the band went right along with the hall, so we'd make about 50-75¢ apiece the nights when he came there.

ctx.x: Was that your pay -- the sack of potatoes?

Yeah. Well, we get a little bit of money once in a while. But then Father Divine used to come in there, and he would -- he would have a big meeting for three or four nights. And the band went right along with the hall, so we'd make about 50-75¢ apiece the nights when he came there. We made pretty good money there because he was drawing a lot of big crowds, you know.
